sheet.layout: Six frames in a 3 by 2 grid, read left to right, top to bottom. IMPORTANT LAYOUT: in every frame she is small, about 45 percent of her grid cell height, centred, with very wide empty space all around her so every prop, swing arc, hair strand, ribbon and effect stays fully inside her own cell with a clear gap to the edges; frames never touch each other. Full body, side view facing right unless a frame says otherwise. Same character, same size, feet on one shared baseline, plain flat light grey background, no text, no borders, no grid lines, no extra people, no floor shadow.

She carries a cluster of small gold bells on a crimson cord.
art.personality: Calm, serene and graceful; flowing dance motion, long sleeves and ribbons trailing.
art.layout: Six frames in a 3 by 2 grid, read left to right, top to bottom. IMPORTANT LAYOUT: in every frame she is small, about 45 percent of her grid cell height, centred, with very wide empty space all around her so every prop, swing arc, hair strand, ribbon and effect stays fully inside her own cell with a clear gap to the edges; frames never touch each other. Full body, side view facing right unless a frame says otherwise. Same character, same size, feet on one shared baseline, plain flat light grey background, no text, no borders, no grid lines, no extra people, no floor shadow.

sheets.idle: A SPRITE SHEET of six separate small full-body figures of her, never one big portrait: a looping standing idle, both feet planted on the ground, side view facing right: 1 relaxed stance holding her gold bells on a crimson cord; 2 hair and ribbons stirring left; 3 a small shift of weight; 4 a faint confident smile; 5 hair stirring right; 6 back to the first pose. Small calm changes only, a seamless loop.
sheets.run: running cycle, strict side view facing right, body in profile, leaning forward, her gold bells on a crimson cord carried, long hair streaming straight back, six evenly spaced side-view run poses that loop, feet striking the ground. Never facing the viewer.
sheets.jump: a platform jump, side view facing right, holding her gold bells on a crimson cord: 1 a light crouch; 2 pushing off the ground; 3 rising, hair trailing below; 4 top of the jump, knees tucked; 5 falling, hair and skirt flaring upward; 6 landing in a low crouch.
sheets.attack: a ribbon-and-bell dance strike, side view facing right: 1 a dance pose, bells raised; 2 a turning step, sleeves flaring; 3 sweeping the bell cord forward in a wide arc; 4 a spinning strike, ribbons wrapped around her; 5 a high kick, sleeves trailing; 6 a calm bow, bells held to her chest.
sheets.cast: bell chime shockwaves, side view facing right: 1 lifting the bells high; 2 ringing them, small gold chime glyphs appearing; 3 a ring of gold chime shockwave spreading outward from her; 4 ringing again, a second larger ring; 5 a third ring, sleeves floating up; 6 lowering the bells, eyes closed, serene.
sheets.hurt: taking a hit, side view facing right: 1 knocked back a step, hair flaring; 2 flinching, one arm raised to guard; 3 staggering, one knee bending; 4 catching her balance; 5 straightening up, annoyed; 6 back in a ready stance.

art.look: LocutusOfTheEye, an original anime boss for a 2D action game, painted in the same high-end gacha anime style as the design picture: a giant floating eye creature, not a person and with no body or limbs. One huge glossy eyeball with a molten gold iris and a crimson slit pupil, crowned by a black lace eyelid veil with gold filigree and white plum blossoms, long sheer black silk veils and silver-white ribbon strands trailing below, gold chains with red jewels and red tassels, a thin gold halo ring behind it. Never realistic, never gory, never 3D.
art.personality: It floats with slow, regal, hypnotic motion; veils and ribbons drift below it in every frame. NOTE: unlike the other bosses it is a floating eye, so its sheets are idle, move, charge, beam, blink and hurt (no run, jump or attack).
art.layout: Six frames in a 3 by 2 grid, read left to right, top to bottom. IMPORTANT LAYOUT: in every frame it is small, about 45 percent of its grid cell height, centred, with very wide empty space all around its so every prop, swing arc, hair strand, ribbon and effect stays fully inside its own cell with a clear gap to the edges; frames never touch each other. Full body, floating in mid-air, side view facing right unless a frame says otherwise. Same character, same size, floating at one shared height, plain flat light grey background, no text, no borders, no grid lines, no extra people, no floor shadow.

sheets.idle: A SPRITE SHEET of six separate small full-body views of the floating eye, never one big portrait: a looping hover idle, facing right: 1 floating, iris centred; 2 bobbing slightly up, veils drifting left; 3 the iris glowing softly brighter, pulsing; 4 bobbing down; 5 veils drifting right; 6 back to the first pose. Small changes only, a seamless loop.
sheets.move: drifting forward to the right through the air: six evenly spaced frames of the eye gliding forward, tilted slightly forward, veils and ribbons streaming straight back behind it, a seamless loop.
sheets.charge: charging its gaze, facing right: 1 the pupil narrowing; 2 the gold iris starting to glow; 3 small gold sparks drawn inward to the iris; 4 a gold magic circle forming in front of the eye; 5 the iris blazing white-gold; 6 the eye trembling, fully charged.
sheets.beam: firing a gaze beam to the right: 1 the iris blazing; 2 a thin gold beam starting from the pupil; 3 a thick gold-and-crimson beam firing forward, kept inside the cell; 4 the beam sweeping slightly downward; 5 the beam narrowing; 6 the beam fading, iris dimming, small smoke wisps.
sheets.blink: a slow blink, facing right: 1 eye wide open; 2 the black lace eyelid lowering halfway; 3 fully closed, gold filigree eyelid shut; 4 still closed, veils drifting; 5 opening halfway; 6 wide open again, pupil a thin slit.
sheets.hurt: taking a hit, facing right: 1 jolted backward, veils flaring; 2 the eye squeezed half shut; 3 a small crack of light across the iris; 4 wobbling in the air; 5 recovering, eye reopening; 6 glaring, pupil narrowed.
